To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the thin pixel solution with vertical integration technology has been selected as baseline for SuperB.

thin pixel sensors can be manufactured with the vertical integration technology, that the vertical integrated thin pixel sensor can be operated in the SuperB environment, that thin vertical integration pixel sensors can be bump bonded to a CMOS readout ASIC, and that the vertical integration technology is a viable option for the production of the SuperB Layer0.
In summary, our research is concerned with
- the development and characterization of the thin pixel sensors; - the study of the different integration technologies; - the development of the readout electronics.

the optimization of the pixel geometry, in particular with the reduction of the pixel size to 25 μm pitch, and with the optimization of a vertical integration process for the fabrication of the thin pixel sensors.
the development of thin pixel sensors with a pitch as low as 50 µm, a thickness of 50 µm and a resistivity of 1-10 kΩcm.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the thin pixel technology is the best option for Layer0.
the SuperB collaboration is ready to proceed to a full scale prototype with thin pixels, which is the baseline solution for the SuperB Silicon vertex Tracker.
all three technologies can meet the challenging requirements.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated the capability of the thin pixel technology to withstand high background rate and to achieve the required performance.
the thin pixel option is the most promising for the Layer0.
the vertical integration technology is the most promising solution for a thin pixel detector with high radiation tolerance, low material budget, high granularity and fast readout.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of vertical integration technology for the production of thin pixel detectors is feasible.
the use of thin pixels with a pitch as small as 50 µm is a viable solution for a Layer0 with a high granularity and low material budget.
thin pixels with vertical integration technology are the best choice for the Layer0.
